comment: Dev sandbox (devMode, T or Select in the team menu): an arena without obstacles where emitters keep terrain alive, to test terrains and their affinities. Emitters are scenery (no collider, cannot be hit). pokemon: whose sprites they show; offset: their place from the arena centre, in tiles; terrain: key in terrains.json; target: where they paint, from themselves (0,0 = under them); radius in tiles; every: seconds between two refreshes (only the tiles still holding the terrain last longer: a neutralised tile stays so); recast: seconds between two full casts of the zone (15 when omitted); strikes on another patch (a target) are full casts every 'every' seconds; duration: seconds the terrain lasts (longer than every: it never fades); delay: seconds before the first paint. enemyWaves: true sends the first stage's waves on a loop, to see the AIs deal with the terrain (off by default). dummies: Pokémon ids of the training dummies of the obstacle room (enemies that neither move nor attack, at random free tiles); dummyCount of them, level dummyLevel, health × dummyHealth, at least dummyMinDistance tiles from the centre, back dummyRespawn seconds after a knock-out. Z demo room (orange stairs): zDemoCount dummies on a ring of zDemoRadius tiles around the arrival point, health × zDemoHealth, back at their place zDemoRespawn seconds after a knock-out. eliteRoom / bossRoom (yellow stairs bottom left, red stairs at the bottom): the opponent of these fighting rooms, with its AI and ultimate: pokemon, moves (ids; the loadout when empty), level, health ×, respawn seconds after a knock-out, offset from the arrival point. The elite stands beyond a river (R / Select: with or without a bridge). encounterLab (white stairs at the bottom): encounters of Encounters drawn one after the other in a new obstacle room each, fought by the team, played or on autopilot (watch: start in watch mode; V or ○ switches): roundTime seconds at most, team health × teamHealth, the encounter at least distance tiles away, the stage (ranks, evolution) going up every stageEvery rounds.

abilityFocus.comment: the ability room (AbilityDemos) opens on these when not empty: ids of abilities, ids of megas.json

emitters.comment: Ring of steady patches, one per terrain
Demo west: a pool that lightning strikes every 6 s (the whole pool turns electrified)
Demo east: a bramble field that fire sets ablaze every 7 s
